# EncryptionAlgorithm

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Encryption algorithms supported by PDF encryption.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Values

- `RC4_40`: 40-bit RC4 encryption (PDF 1.1+). Legacy encryption, not recommended for new documents.
- `RC4_128`: 128-bit RC4 encryption (PDF 1.4+). Standard encryption for PDF 1.4 compatibility.
- `AES_256`: 256-bit AES encryption (PDF 1.7 Extension Level 3 / PDF 2.0). Requires PDF 1.7 mode.
